reports.title: Haemonetics Reports Second Quarter and First Half Fiscal 2027 Results;

guidance.heading: FISCAL 2027 GUIDANCE
section: The Company updated its previous fiscal 2027 guidance as follows:

Previous Guidance | Current Guidance
Reported Revenue | 5 - 8% | 8 - 11%
53rd week impact | (~2%) | (~2%)
Strategic exits(1) | ~1% | ~1%
Currency impact | 0 - 1% | 0 - 1%
Organic Revenue(2) | 4 - 7% | 6 - 9%
Adjusted operating margin | 50 – 100 bps expansion YoY | 0 – 50 bps expansion YoY
Adjusted earnings per diluted share | Comparable to reported revenue growth | Comparable to reported revenue growth
Free cash flow conversion(3) | ~80% | >80%
